fieldNotes.truckGate: Property is fully fenced (tall chain-link + jersey barriers, confirmed in multiple Street View frames). Sliding/swing gates cross the truck drives at the west face (pano 39.74897,-86.29739) and west yard entrance. Gated controlled access = true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No standalone guard-booth structure resolved in any satellite (z20-21) or Street View frame at the truck entrances. Access appears badge/kiosk controlled. Set false; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Truck gate present but no manned booth visible -> remote/kiosk check-in inferred = true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock-door banks run the full west face and the long south face of the 1.4M sq ft building; well over 50 doors (~180 est.).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Massive multi-row trailer drop yards on the west and south sides, hundreds of Target-branded trailers in marked stalls -> 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock banks on different building faces (long west face and long south face) -> ship/rcv likely on separate faces.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale/weigh pad resolved at the entrances; set false.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Multiple separated truck access points (west drive + west-yard drive + SE circulation road) rather than one consolidated in/out gate.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~72 acres of fenced, paved truck-operations area from the perimeter ring (building ~1.4M sq ft plus surrounding yards); approximate.
